●　「ライトライナー」を一部新規造形を交え、初立体化。

さらに、付属のクリアカラーのディスプレイスタンドを使用することで飛行ポーズで展示することが可能。

en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN" MSD (Mobile Suit Discovery),
The flight support mechanism "Lightliner" is made into a three-dimensional model for the first time. The large wing is precisely reproduced with some new modeling.
Can be combined with Gunpla by grip, leg holding arm, and waist connection joint.
● "Light Liner" has been made into three-dimensional for the first time with some new modeling.
Accurately reproduces the large wing aircraft-specific mold. The grip and leg holding arm are movable, and can be connected to the MS body (sold separately) at the waist joint.
Furthermore, by using the included clear color display stand, it is possible to display it in a flying pose.
<Recommended combination kit> *Sold separately.
